title: Brazilian Portuguese - Internet Culture Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description: Project Overview Help shape the future of AI in Brazil! We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market. We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Internet Culture (memes, social challenges, and street interviews-related) to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese. Suitable backgrounds may include digital culture research, social media strategy, meme analysis, online community management, content creation, internet journalism, or cultural commentary focused on Brazilian online spaces. Relevant profiles could include influencers, digital marketers, trend analysts, professional content creators, podcast hosts, street interview creators, or individuals with recognized experience studying or shaping internet culture, viral trends, social challenges, and online communities in Brazil. Please submit your resume/CV in English.
min_qualifications: Native or fluent proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field Demonstrated expertise through academic background and/or industry experience Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, structured manner Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality output in a guideline-driven environment Nice to Have Experience with content creation, research, education, or knowledge evaluation Familiarity with AI training, data annotation, or evaluation projects Background in interdisciplinary work (e.g. media studies, sociology, digital anthropology, online communities, platform culture) #LI-CAN17
